author: evans
title: Commentary on the Whole Bible, Volume VI (Acts to Revelation): Romans, by John Evans
edition: Matthew Henry, Exposition of the Old and New Testaments (1706-1721), the exposition of Romans written by John Evans from Henry's notes; CCEL edition

rights.worldwide: to confirm: death dates of every author and editor named (life + 70 years); Matthew Henry died in 1714 and John Evans in 1730

notes: Matthew Henry died in 1714, having reached the end of Acts; the exposition of the Epistles was completed from his notes by other ministers, and Romans, as the CCEL edition's own heading says, was 'Completed by John Evans'. The work is therefore Evans's (library/authors/evans.json); its id, henry-romans, is kept because published ids do not change. Romans 1–16 are CCEL mhc6 Rom.ii–Rom.xvii. Every paragraph of exposition is kept, in the order printed, in entries of up to about 350 words; a paragraph cut between entries is marked with ' ...'. Each of the exposition's points is placed on the verse it names near its start ('(v. 7)', 'v. 11-15'); a main point (I., II.) that names none is on the whole section of verses it stands under, and a lesser point (1., (1.)) that names none on the verse of the point before it. A one-line lead-in ('In this paragraph we have,') goes with the point after it. The chapter summaries before the sections, and the Bible text printed above each section, are left out. The Open Word Bible text has no Romans 16:25-27 (its pinned SBLGNT data lacks the doxology), so the exposition of those verses is not included until the verses are.
